issue.title: attitude_euler bug

comments.body: Oh, that's not good! Thanks for reporting.

One thing. Are you sure that you don't have two vehicles sending an attitude? E.g. a real one and a SITL instance broadcasting in the network?

And FYI the attitude is assembed from either `ATTITUDE` or `ATTITUDE_QUATERNION` messages, so either something is somewhere wrong in the implementation (probably in MAVSDK) or there are multiple sources mixed.

yep, only one vehicle :)
The same setup has worked for me in the past, only difference is that i just updated MAVSDK.
By the way, i was using a Pixhawk 2.1 running px4 v1.10.1 if that makes any difference.
It turns out that the conversion function was just wrong. With #1120 it might be fixed.

Had the same issue with v0.28.0, v0.29.0 fixed it.
Thanks!
